name: KTeaTime
blurb: KTeaTime is a handy timer for steeping tea.
description: KTeaTime is a handy timer for steeping tea. No longer will you have to guess at how long it takes for your tea to be ready. Simply select the type of tea you have, and it will alert you when the tea is ready to drink.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
